import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AdminLoanResponse, ItemResponse, LoanResponse, Page } from "../../../../shared/schemas.ts";
import type { SessionResponse } from "../../../../shared/schemas.ts";
import { errorMessage, request } from "../../lib/api.ts";

const Items = Page(ItemResponse), Loans = Page(LoanResponse), Overview = Page(AdminLoanResponse);

function Availability({ items, busy, reserve }: { items: ItemResponse[]; busy: boolean; reserve: (id: string, name: string) => void }) {
  return <><h3>Availability</h3>{items.length === 0 ? <p>No equipment is listed yet.</p> : <ul>{items.map(item => <li key={item.id}>
    <p>{item.name} · {item.available ? "Available" : "On loan"}</p>
    {item.available && <button disabled={busy} onClick={() => reserve(item.id, item.name)}>Reserve {item.name}</button>}
  </li>)}</ul>}</>;
}
function OwnLoans({ loans, busy, giveBack }: { loans: LoanResponse[]; busy: boolean; giveBack: (id: string, name: string) => void }) {
  return <><h3>Your loans</h3>{loans.length === 0 ? <p>You have no loans.</p> : <ul>{loans.map(loan => <li key={loan.id}>
    <p>{loan.itemName} · {loan.returnedAt === null ? "Active" : "Returned"}</p>
    {loan.returnedAt === null && <button disabled={busy} onClick={() => giveBack(loan.id, loan.itemName)}>Return {loan.itemName}</button>}
  </li>)}</ul>}</>;
}
function Borrowers({ loans }: { loans: AdminLoanResponse[] }) {
  return loans.length === 0 ? <p>No loans have been recorded.</p> : <ul>{loans.map(loan => <li key={loan.id}>{loan.itemName} · {loan.borrower.email} · {loan.returnedAt === null ? "Active" : "Returned"}</li>)}</ul>;
}
const size = 25;

export function LoanDesk({ session }: { session: SessionResponse }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ReturnType<typeof Items.parse> | null>(null);
  const [loans, setLoans] = useState<ReturnType<typeof Loans.parse> | null>(null);
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<ReturnType<typeof Overview.parse> | null>(null);
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState({ items: 0, loans: 0, overview: 0 });
  const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0), [loading, setLoading] = useState(true), [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [issue, setIssue] = useState<{ message: string } | null>(null), [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState("");
  const pending = useRef(false), alert = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const admin = session.user.role === "admin";
  useEffect(() => { heading.current?.focus(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { if (issue) alert.current?.focus(); }, [issue]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true); setIssue(null);
    const query = (start: number) => `?limit=${size}&offset=${start}`;
    async function load() {
      // StrictMode can dispose this view before its first read; do not dispatch an already abandoned load.
      await Promise.resolve();
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const [nextItems, nextLoans, nextOverview] = await Promise.all([
      request(`/api/items${query(offset.items)}`, { signal: controller.signal }).then(body => Items.parse(body)),
      request(`/api/loans${query(offset.loans)}`, { signal: controller.signal }).then(body => Loans.parse(body)),
      admin ? request(`/api/admin/loans${query(offset.overview)}`, { signal: controller.signal }).then(body => Overview.parse(body)) : null,
    ]);
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setItems(nextItems); setLoans(nextLoans); setOverview(nextOverview); }
    }
    void load().catch(error => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setIssue({ message: errorMessage(error) }); })
      .finally(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false); });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [admin, offset, retry]);

  async function change(path: string, message: string) {
    if (pending.current) return;
    pending.current = true; setBusy(true); setIssue(null); setConfirmation("");
    try {
      LoanResponse.parse(await request(path, { method: "POST", headers: { "x-csrf-token": session.csrfToken } }));
      // Success is visible only after all three views have been independently re-read.
      const [nextItems, nextLoans, nextOverview] = await Promise.all([
        request(`/api/items?limit=${size}&offset=${offset.items}`).then(body => Items.parse(body)),
        request(`/api/loans?limit=${size}&offset=${offset.loans}`).then(body => Loans.parse(body)),
        admin ? request(`/api/admin/loans?limit=${size}&offset=${offset.overview}`).then(body => Overview.parse(body)) : null,
      ]);
      setItems(nextItems); setLoans(nextLoans); setOverview(nextOverview); setConfirmation(message);
      heading.current?.focus();
    } catch (error) { setIssue({ message: `${errorMessage(error)} Refresh equipment to check the current state before trying again.` }); }
    finally { pending.current = false; setBusy(false); }
  }
  function pages(key: keyof typeof offset, total: number) {
    return <div aria-label={`${key} pages`}>
      <button disabled={busy || loading || offset[key] === 0} onClick={() => setOffset(current => ({ ...current, [key]: Math.max(0, current[key] - size) }))}>Previous {key}</button>{" "}
      <button disabled={busy || loading || offset[key] + size >= total} onClick={() => setOffset(current => ({ ...current, [key]: current[key] + size }))}>Next {key}</button>
      <p>Page {Math.floor(offset[key] / size) + 1} · {total} total</p>
    </div>;
  }
  return <section id="equipment" aria-labelledby="equipment-title">
    <h2 id="equipment-title" ref={heading} tabIndex={-1}>Equipment</h2>
    <p>Reserve available equipment and return your own loans.</p>
    {issue && <div className="notice" role="alert" tabIndex={-1} ref={alert}>{issue.message}</div>}
    <p aria-live="polite">{loading ? "Loading equipment…" : busy ? "Confirming the change…" : confirmation}</p>
    <button disabled={busy || loading} onClick={() => { setConfirmation(""); setRetry(n => n + 1); }}>Refresh equipment</button>
    {!loading && !issue && <>
      {items && <><Availability items={items.items} busy={busy} reserve={(id, name) => { void change(`/api/items/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/reserve`, `${name} reserved.`); }} />{pages("items", items.total)}</>}
      {loans && <><OwnLoans loans={loans.items} busy={busy} giveBack={(id, name) => { void change(`/api/loans/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/return`, `${name} returned.`); }} />{pages("loans", loans.total)}</>}
      {overview && <section aria-labelledby="overview-title"><h3 id="overview-title">Loan overview</h3>
        <Borrowers loans={overview.items} />
        {pages("overview", overview.total)}
      </section>}
    </>}
  </section>;
}
